event.title: Maine Democrats Set to Nominate Troy Jackson for Senate Race
event.canonical_title: Maine Democrats Set to Nominate Troy Jackson for Senate Race
event.summary: Maine Democrats are convening to select a Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner, with former state Senate President Troy Jackson expected to secure the nomination. Jackson, who comes from a logging family, is preparing to challenge Republican Senator Susan Collins in the upcoming election, which is being closely watched nationally. Collins has significantly outpaced Jackson in fundraising, raising over $16 million compared to Jackson's $1 million since entering the race.

key_facts: Maine Democrats are meeting to select a Senate nominee.
Troy Jackson is the expected nominee to replace Graham Platner.

He will challenge Republican Senator Susan Collins in the election.
Collins has raised over $16 million, while Jackson has raised more than $1 million.

timeline.title: Troy Jackson Secures Democratic Nomination for US Senate in Maine
timeline.summary: Troy Jackson, a former state lawmaker and logger, has been chosen as the Democratic nominee for the US Senate in Maine. He will challenge incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins in the upcoming November election. Jackson replaces Graham Platner, who initially won the Democratic primary in June.
